import json, subprocess
def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    if p.returncode: print('EXIT', p.stderr.decode()[:400]); return None
    return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
def case(name, cname, frames, expect=None):
    return {"name":cname,"frames":frames,"expect":expect or {"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h.example"}}
def hdr(end=False):
    return {"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":path","/"]],"End_Stream":end}
def doc(cases, channels, events=None):
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":cases,"events":events or [],
            "channels":channels}
def part(owner, data):
    return {"case":owner,"data":data}
def show(name, out):
    print(name)
    for c in out['cases']:
        print('  case', c['name'], c['state'], 'origin_count', c['origin_count'], 'flags', c['flags'], 'rf', c['request_frames'])
    for ch in out['channels']:
        for r in ch['requests']:
            print('  req', r['start'], r['end'], 'owner', r['owner'], 'owners', r['owners'], 'flags', r['flags'], 'host_count', r['host_count'])

# unattributed + unsent + missing_origin + unsent_origin
c = [case('a','a',[hdr(True)]), case('b','b',[])]
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part(None,"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('unattributed', run(doc(c,ch)))
# unsent: owner b has no request frames
c = [case('a','a',[hdr(True)]), case('b','b',[{"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"z"}])]
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('b',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('unsent', run(doc(c,ch)))
# extra: same owner twice in one channel
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"*2)]}]
show('extra single channel', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
# extra across channels: byte order within each channel, channel-array order
ch = [{"name":"c1","parts":[part('a',"GET /1 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"), part('a',"GET /2 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n")]},
      {"name":"c2","parts":[part('a',"GET /3 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('extra across channels', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
# mixed owner
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n"), part('b',"Content-Length: 0\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('mixed owner', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)]), case('b','b',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
# multiple host
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nhost: h.example\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('multiple host', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
# identity variants
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"POST /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: OTHER\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('identity method+host(case-fold)', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('identity target', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.EXAMPLE\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('host fold ok', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('missing host identity', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
# missing_origin
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part(None,"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n")]}]
show('missing_origin', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
# extra_origin + unsent_origin
ch = [{"name":"c","parts":[part('a',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"*3)]}]
show('extra_origin', run(doc([case('a','a',[hdr(True)])],ch)))
PYEOF
